algorithm_rules.rule: During stance or double support, projected CoM should remain within the support polygon plus a small visual tolerance.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Reject or correct frames where the character appears to tip despite planted feet.

algorithm_rules.rule: When a foot is in stance phase, world-space foot translation should be near zero unless intentional slip is authored.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Lock planted foot, solve pelvis/knee with IK, and release at toe-off.

algorithm_rules.rule: A walking step reads more naturally when heel contact, flat support, and toe-off phases are distinguishable.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Add keyframe markers or foot roll constraints around contact transitions.

algorithm_rules.rule: Root/CoM path should be smooth and coherent with step cadence; abrupt root speed changes break walking weight.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Low-pass smooth pelvis/root travel and keep stride distance consistent with footfall timing.

algorithm_rules.rule: Swing foot should clear the ground enough to avoid visual scraping but not float excessively.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Clamp swing arc to model scale and terrain height.

algorithm_rules.rule: IK corrections must preserve temporal continuity; knee/ankle/hip jumps are worse than mild pose error.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Use bounded per-frame joint deltas and smooth correction weights across contact phases.

algorithm_rules.rule: Many robots/environments should collect short rollouts in parallel, while only selected episodes are rendered for human review.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Train headless at scale, then export score, success/NG, collision, energy, and GIF/GLB evidence for dashboard inspection.

algorithm_rules.rule: Household autonomy should progress from approach and posture tasks to long-horizon object-state tasks.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Score simple robot tasks as walk -> reach -> open/close -> sit/stand -> multi-step kitchen or care assistance.

algorithm_rules.rule: Factory robot policies must track task success together with safety-zone, collision, force, alignment, and cycle-time constraints.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Add separate factory reward terms for fixture alignment, part handling, safety-zone avoidance, and failed-grasp recovery.

algorithm_rules.rule: Real robot deployment requires a restricted edge controller, emergency stop, speed/force limits, and simulator-to-hardware validation.
algorithm_rules.motion_use: Convert learned behaviors into Raspberry Pi/ROS 2/microcontroller profiles only after offline replay and safety gates pass.
